disclaimer: Fictional records for the ResolveNest demo. Not real product, customer or defect data.

records.title: Dashboard image export fails for charts with more than 1,000 points
records.description: Exporting a dashboard as PNG fails with 'Render timeout' when any line chart has more than 1,000 data points.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v1.9.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v1.9.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Aggregate the chart by week before exporting.

records.title: Scheduled report subject line drops non-ASCII characters
records.description: Accented and non-Latin characters in scheduled report email subjects are replaced with question marks.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v1.9.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Use ASCII characters in the subject template.

records.title: API returns 500 when a filter value contains a comma
records.description: GET requests with filter values containing an unescaped comma fail with HTTP 500 instead of being parsed or rejected with 400.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v1.9.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Percent-encode commas in filter values.

records.title: Import silently truncates text fields longer than 255 characters
records.description: Text values longer than 255 characters are cut off during import without a warning in the import summary.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Split long notes into multiple fields before importing.

records.title: CSV export escapes quotes incorrectly in multi-line text fields
records.description: Double quotes inside multi-line text values are not doubled, so spreadsheet tools split the row into several broken rows.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v1.9.1.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.2 release notes.
records.workaround: Export as XLSX for reports with multi-line notes.

records.title: SAML signing certificate rollover not applied until the next deploy
records.description: A newly uploaded IdP certificate is stored but not used for signature validation until the application is redeployed, so sign-ins fail after the IdP switches certificates.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.3 release notes.
records.workaround: Keep the IdP on the old certificate until support confirms the reload.

records.title: Offset pagination skips records when sorting by updated_at
records.description: Records updated while an integration pages through /v2/records with sort=updated_at move between pages and are skipped.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.2 release notes.
records.workaround: Sort by id when paginating with offsets.

records.title: Scheduled report fails when the schedule owner is deactivated
records.description: Schedules owned by a deactivated user fail with status failed_owner and no notification is sent to administrators.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.0.
records.workaround: Transfer schedules to an active user before deactivating the owner. See KB-026.

records.title: Webhook test button always reports success
records.description: The webhook test console shows 'Delivered' even when the receiver returns an error or the request times out.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Check the delivery log for the real response code.

records.title: Role changes take up to 10 minutes to apply
records.description: Permission changes on a role are cached for up to 10 minutes, so users keep their old access until the cache expires.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.1.
records.workaround: Product decision: permission cache TTL is intentional for performance. Ask users to sign out and in again.

records.title: Connector sync stalls after OAuth token refresh
records.description: After the source system's OAuth access token is refreshed, the connector keeps using the expired token and every run stays in running state.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.2.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.1.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Disable and re-enable the connector. See KB-022.

records.title: Rate limit counter not reset at window boundary for burst requests
records.description: Bursts of requests at the end of a rate limit window are counted in the next window as well, causing unexpected 429 responses.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.0.3 release notes.
records.workaround: Spread requests evenly across the minute.

records.title: PDF export ignores report page margins
records.description: Custom page margins set in the report print layout are ignored and the default 10 mm margins are used.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.1.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.1.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Adjust column widths instead of margins.

records.title: Dashboard date picker defaults to UTC instead of the workspace timezone
records.description: The default date range on dashboards is computed in UTC, so 'Today' starts at the wrong hour for non-UTC workspaces.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.2.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.1.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Select explicit dates instead of relative ranges.

records.title: Token last-used timestamp not updated for read-only requests
records.description: The Last used column in Settings > API Tokens only changes when a token performs a write request.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.3.
records.workaround: Use the API audit log to check read activity. See KB-029.

records.title: Connector field mapping lost after renaming a source column
records.description: Renaming a column in the source system removes its field mapping, so the target field stays empty on every following sync.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Reported against the 2.0 line; the exact patch version was not recorded.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.2.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Remap the field after renaming. See KB-037.

records.title: Import preview shows wrong row numbers for files with blank lines
records.description: Blank lines are skipped when counting rows, so validation errors in the preview point to the wrong row numbers.
records.workaround: Remove blank lines before importing.

records.title: MFA prompt loops in Safari private browsing
records.description: In Safari private windows, the MFA challenge reappears after a correct code because the session cookie cannot be stored.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.1.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.1.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Use a normal browser window. See KB-025.

records.title: API ignores If-None-Match for /v2/reports
records.description: Conditional GET requests with If-None-Match always return 200 with a full body instead of 304.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.1.0.

records.title: Webhook delivery log shows response time in the wrong unit
records.description: The delivery log labels response times as milliseconds while the values are microseconds.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.0.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.2.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Divide the displayed value by 1,000.

records.title: Incremental sync re-imports all rows after a daylight-saving change
records.description: On the night of a daylight-saving transition the incremental sync cursor is reset and the connector re-imports every record.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.2.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.3.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Pause connectors during the daylight-saving transition.

records.title: Dashboard share links expire after 24 hours instead of 30 days
records.description: Public share links created on 2.2.0 expire after one day although the dialog says 30 days.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.2.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.2.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Recreate the share link daily.

records.title: 429 responses missing the Retry-After header
records.description: Rate-limited requests receive 429 without a Retry-After header, so clients retry immediately and stay throttled.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.2.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Back off for 60 seconds after a 429. See KB-020.

records.title: PDF export truncates tables wider than the page
records.description: Reports with more than 12 columns lose the right-most columns when exported to PDF. The new layout engine does not wrap or scale wide tables.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to the PDF layout engine shipped in v2.1.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix merged in PR-3982 and listed in the v2.1.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Switch the PDF page orientation to landscape or hide unused columns before exporting.

records.title: CSV export uses the browser timezone instead of the report timezone for timestamps
records.description: Timestamp columns in CSV exports are converted to the downloading user's browser timezone instead of the report's configured timezone.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.2.1.
records.workaround: Set the report timezone to match the users' timezone.

records.title: Scheduled report runs twice when edited during execution
records.description: Saving a schedule while its run is in progress queues an additional run with the new settings.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.2.1.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Edit schedules only between runs.

records.title: Scheduled reports delivered twice on daylight-saving transitions
records.description: On the night a timezone switches to or from daylight-saving time, scheduled reports set to run at 01:00-03:00 local time are executed twice.
records.fix_evidence: Scheduler now stores run times in UTC. Listed in the v2.2.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Schedule reports outside the 01:00-03:00 local window.

records.title: Bulk role assignment fails for more than 500 users
records.description: Assigning a role to more than 500 selected users fails with 'Request too large' and no users are updated.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.3.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Assign roles in batches of 500.

records.title: Dashboard filters reset after browser back navigation
records.description: Applying dashboard filters, opening a widget drill-down and pressing the browser back button resets all filters to their defaults.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Introduced by the filter panel redesign in v2.1.0.
records.fix_evidence: Filter state is now persisted in the URL. Listed in the v2.2.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Open drill-downs in a new tab.

records.title: API returns 404 instead of 403 for reports in restricted folders
records.description: GET /v2/reports/{id} returns 404 Not Found when the caller lacks folder access, which hides the real permission problem.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.3.0.
records.workaround: Check folder membership when a known report returns 404. See KB-034.

records.title: Sync status shows Completed while the last batch is still running
records.description: The connector run is marked Completed before its final batch commits, so records appear a few minutes after the run ends.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.3.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Wait five minutes after a run completes before checking records.

records.title: SAML login loops when the IdP clock is ahead by more than 2 minutes
records.description: The SAML assertion validator applied zero tolerance to NotBefore, so users were redirected back to the IdP repeatedly when the IdP clock was slightly ahead.
records.fix_evidence: A 3-minute clock skew tolerance was added. Listed in the v2.2.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Synchronize the IdP server clock with NTP.

records.title: Webhook signing secret rotation invalidates the old secret immediately
records.description: Rotating an endpoint's signing secret invalidates the previous secret at once, so receivers reject deliveries until they are updated.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.3.1.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Update the receiver immediately after rotating. See KB-027.

records.title: PDF export of dashboards omits the last widget row
records.description: When a dashboard is exported to PDF, the bottom row of widgets is missing if the dashboard height is not a multiple of the page height.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.3.1.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Add an empty text widget at the bottom of the dashboard.

records.title: Data import rejects CSV files saved with a UTF-8 byte-order mark
records.description: Files exported from spreadsheet tools with a UTF-8 BOM fail validation because the first header is read as '\ufeffaccount_id'.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Reporter states the problem started on the 2.2 line; the exact patch version was never recorded.
records.fix_evidence: BOM stripping added to the rewritten import pipeline. Listed in the v2.3.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Save the file as 'CSV (comma delimited)' without BOM.

records.title: Role editor allows saving a role with no permissions
records.description: Custom roles can be saved with an empty permission set. Users assigned to such a role can sign in but see a blank workspace.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Custom role editor first shipped in v2.2.0.
records.workaround: Product decision: empty roles are allowed for staged onboarding. Documented in KB-007.

records.title: Dashboard widgets show stale cached results for up to 15 minutes
records.description: Widget query cache is not invalidated when the underlying dataset refreshes, so figures can lag the source data by up to 15 minutes.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Cache layer introduced in v2.2.0.
records.fix_evidence: Cache invalidation on dataset refresh. Listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Use the widget menu 'Refresh now'.

records.title: Scheduled report emails omit attachments larger than 10 MB
records.description: When a scheduled report attachment exceeds 10 MB the email is sent without the attachment and without an error message.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Mail relay size limit introduced with the email provider change in v2.2.1.
records.workaround: Enable 'Send as download link' in the schedule settings.

records.title: API cursor pagination returns duplicate rows
records.description: Paginating /v2/transactions with a page size above 200 can return the last row of one page again as the first row of the next page.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Cursor pagination introduced in v2.2.0.
records.fix_evidence: Cursor now encodes a tiebreaker column. Listed in the v2.3.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Use page sizes of 200 or less, or de-duplicate by transaction id.

records.title: PDF export renders non-Latin characters as empty boxes
records.description: Japanese, Thai and Arabic text is rendered as placeholder boxes in PDF exports because the fallback font set is missing.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Font bundle trimmed during the v2.3.0 build size reduction.
records.fix_evidence: Noto fallback fonts restored. Listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Export as XLSX and print from a spreadsheet tool.

records.title: Data import progress bar stuck at 99%
records.description: The import completes in the background but the progress bar never reaches 100% and the summary screen is not shown.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Introduced by the import pipeline rewrite in v2.3.0.
records.fix_evidence: Completion event now emitted after the final batch. Listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Reload the import history page to see the completed import.

records.title: CSV export fails with ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE when a report contains custom date fields
records.description: The streaming CSV serializer introduced in 2.3.0 throws on custom date fields that have a null value or a non-ISO display format. The export is aborted, the user sees 'Export failed (ERR_EXPORT_SERIALIZE)' and the downloaded file is 0 bytes. Scheduled reports that attach CSV files send an empty attachment. XLSX and PDF exports are not affected.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression bisected to the streaming CSV export engine shipped in v2.3.0 (PR-4471).
records.fix_evidence: Fix merged in PR-5120: null-safe date formatting in the CSV serializer. Shipped in v2.3.2 and listed in its release notes. Verified by QA on 2026-08-03.
records.workaround: Export the report as XLSX, or remove custom date columns from the report before exporting to CSV. See KB-012.

records.title: CSV export column order differs from the on-screen report layout
records.description: Columns that were reordered in the report viewer are exported in their original definition order.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Column reordering in the viewer was added in v2.1.0 without updating the exporter.
records.workaround: Reorder columns in the report definition instead of the viewer.

records.title: Token scope picker hides reports:write for organization admins
records.description: Organization admins creating a service token do not see the reports:write scope in the picker, although they are allowed to grant it.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Scope picker UI rebuilt in v2.3.0.
records.fix_evidence: Scope list now derived from the admin permission set. Listed in the v2.3.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Create the token through POST /v2/tokens with the scope listed explicitly.

records.title: Large CSV exports time out after 120 seconds
records.description: Exports above roughly 500,000 rows exceed the 120-second gateway timeout and fail with 'Export timed out'. Smaller exports of the same report succeed.
records.workaround: Split the export by date range, or use the asynchronous export API. See KB-014.

records.title: SSO users lose their role assignment after nightly SCIM sync
records.description: Users provisioned through SCIM whose IdP group name contains a slash are reassigned to the default Viewer role during the nightly sync.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Group name parser change in v2.3.1.
records.fix_evidence: Group names are now matched verbatim. Listed in the v2.4.0 release notes.
records.workaround: Rename IdP groups to avoid '/' characters.

records.title: Dashboards render blank in Safari 17
records.description: After the v2.4.0 rendering upgrade, dashboards load an empty canvas in Safari 17. Other browsers are not affected.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Started with the dashboard rendering upgrade in v2.4.0.
records.workaround: Use a Chromium-based browser or Firefox.

records.title: Expired API tokens return 403 Forbidden instead of 401 Unauthorized
records.description: Requests with an expired token receive 403 with error 'insufficient_scope' instead of 401 'token_expired', which misleads integrators into checking scopes.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Scoped token middleware introduced in v2.2.0.
records.workaround: Check the token expiry date in Settings > API Tokens before investigating scopes. See KB-015.

records.title: Webhook retry backoff ignores the receiver's Retry-After header
records.description: When a receiver responds 429 or 503 with Retry-After, the dispatcher still uses its own exponential schedule (1, 5, 15, 45 minutes). Found during code review; no customer impact has been confirmed.

records.title: Scheduled reports skip runs for timezones at UTC+13 or UTC+14
records.description: The v2.4.0 timezone engine computes the next run date one day late for UTC+13 and UTC+14 offsets, so daily runs are skipped every other day.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Introduced by the scheduled report timezone engine in v2.4.0.
records.workaround: Set the schedule timezone to UTC and adjust the run hour.

records.title: X-RateLimit-Reset header reports milliseconds instead of seconds
records.description: The X-RateLimit-Reset header contains milliseconds, so clients that follow it wait 1,000 times longer than necessary.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Divide X-RateLimit-Reset by 1,000 on 2.4.0.

records.title: Analyst role receives 403 on reports in shared folders
records.description: Users with the Analyst role get 403 Forbidden in the UI and API for reports in shared folders even when they are folder members.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.1 release notes.
records.workaround: Temporarily grant the Editor folder role. See KB-034.

records.title: Dashboard filter dropdown truncates values longer than 40 characters
records.description: Long filter values are cut at 40 characters in the dropdown and values with the same prefix cannot be distinguished.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.0.
records.workaround: Type in the dropdown to search. See KB-035.

records.title: Scheduled report preview shows the previous run's data
records.description: The preview pane in the schedule editor shows cached results from the last run instead of current data.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.2 release notes.
records.workaround: Open the report itself to preview current data.

records.title: invoice webhooks omit the occurred_at field
records.description: Payloads for invoice.paid and invoice.voided events are missing occurred_at, so receivers cannot order invoice events.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.1.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.2 release notes.
records.workaround: Use the delivery timestamp until upgrading.

records.title: Dashboards with more than 40 widgets take over 20 seconds to load
records.description: The 2.4.0 rendering engine loads widgets sequentially, so dashboards with more than 40 widgets take over 20 seconds to become interactive.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.2 release notes.
records.workaround: Split large dashboards. See KB-023.

records.title: Connector sync retries indefinitely on HTTP 401 from the source
records.description: When the source system returns 401, the connector retries every minute instead of pausing and asking for re-authorization.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.1.
records.workaround: Disable and reconnect the connector. See KB-022.

records.title: Import rejects DD.MM.YYYY dates although the workspace locale uses them
records.description: Date columns in DD.MM.YYYY format fail validation even when the workspace locale is set to German or Swiss formats.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.1.
records.workaround: Use ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). See KB-033.

records.title: SCIM deprovisioning leaves API tokens of removed users active
records.description: Users deactivated through SCIM lose UI access, but their personal API tokens keep working until they expire.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.0.
records.fix_evidence: Fix listed in the v2.4.2 release notes.
records.workaround: Revoke tokens of deprovisioned users manually. See KB-030.

records.title: CSV export file name contains the report ID instead of the report name
records.description: Since 2.4.2, downloaded CSV files are named like report-8f3c2a.csv instead of using the report name.
records.introduced_in_evidence: Regression traced to changes shipped in v2.4.2.
records.workaround: Rename the file after download.
